learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialization, at the level necessary to acquire the rest of the degree's competences, including notions of the latest advances.
Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Engineering analysis: The ability to analyze complex products, processes, and systems in their field of study; to choose and apply appropriately established analytical, calculation, and experimental methods and to correctly interpret the results of such analyses.

Engineering analysis: The ability to identify, formulate, and solve engineering problems in their specialization; to appropriately choose and apply established analytical, calculation, and experimental methods; to recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial constraints.

Research and innovation: Ability to conduct bibliographic searches, consult and critically use databases and other sources of information, to carry out simulation and analysis with the objective of conducting research on technical topics in their specialization.
Research and innovation: Ability to consult and apply codes of good practice and safety in their specialization.
Research and innovation: Ability and skill to design and conduct experimental research, interpret results, and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, design, and research, and their limitations in the scope of their specialization.
Practical application of engineering: Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects, and conduct research specific to their specialization.

Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment, and tools, engineering technology and processes, and their limitations in the scope of their specialization.
Practical application of engineering: Ability to apply standards of engineering practice in their specialization.
Judgment formulation: Ability to collect and interpret data and manage complex concepts within their specialization, to make judgments that involve reflection on ethical and social issues.
Judgment formulation: Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialization, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.

Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers as well as people from other disciplines.
Continuous training: Ability to stay updated on new developments in science and technology.
Able to create and visualize products based on complex surfaces using 3D modeling software.
Knowledge of the current landscape of industrial design and its different aesthetic currents, in addition to understanding and applying industrial design methodologies and tools.

syllabus_topics: Design phases. Different methodologies. Work tools
Phases, tools, and techniques of the creative process
teaching_methods: Computer simulation practices, individually and/or in teams
Problem-solving and project practices in real and/or simulated contexts
Classroom presentation in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects

assessment_methods.method: Reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices
Technical capability, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation delivered, technical presentation and defense
Technical capability, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation delivered, technical presentation and defense
Observation of student participation and attitude in the proposed formative activities
